## Overview

This 2026-09-15 Adyen Docs page is an Android integration chooser for Klarna Debit Risk. It links separate method-specific Drop-in and Components guides, plus main Android Sessions and Advanced integration guides. It does not itself specify payment request fields, eligibility, version requirements, payment outcomes, or capture and settlement behavior. See [[adyen]] and [[adyen-online-payments]].

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in route is described as an all-in-one UI option; the Components route names `InstantPaymentComponent` for handling the redirect to Klarna Debit Risk. These are navigation descriptions, not implementation steps.
- The page says to create the main integration before adding Klarna Debit Risk, and lists Android Drop-in and Components base guides for both Sessions and Advanced flows. Follow the relevant child guide for method-specific behavior and qualifications.
